Then, you can use the quadratic formula, which is x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a). Plug in the values of a, b, and c into the formula, and simplify to find the values of x.

To find the stationary points of an equation y = f(x), you need to find the derivative of the function, f'(x). Set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x.
